name: Mercenary Grappling Hook
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Grappling Hook (players/thief/mercenary/grappling_hook_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): range 175 (200); stun 0.5 s (1.25 s); mana 20 (5). Its own mana 20 (5), cooldown 0.25 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: The hook reaches 175 instead of 200 and stuns for 0.5 s; you still evade everything while you travel.
